question: Would frozen 100K GPTrans weights on the 500K internal-development cohort flag a known sub-threshold 500K retraining outcome?

hypothesis.observed_deficiency: The 100K pair_update_norm gain passed 0.003 eV, but its 500K retraining gain was only 0.001140 eV.
alternative_explanations: The gain may persist across evaluation cohorts and disappear only after longer 500K optimization.
hypothesis.changed_mechanism: No model change; compare two existing frozen 100K checkpoints on the fixed 500K development cohort.
hypothesis.cheapest_falsifier: Local inference on the existing, SHA-pinned 50K development shard.
hypothesis.decision_changed_if_positive: Treat frozen transfer as a useful risk flag to test on more historical winners, without activating an automatic gate.
hypothesis.decision_changed_if_negative: Do not use frozen transfer alone to screen 500K retraining candidates.

state_at_start.source_config_identity: GPTrans-T 12x256 pair32 100K seed42 EMA best; two SHA-pinned checkpoints; accepted fixed 500K OGB graph shard

provenance.chronology_status: prospective creation time and executed script commit not independently established
provenance.acceptance_scope: retained prediction hash, row order, finite values and metric recomputation only

next_allowed_actions: Do not activate a frozen-weight transfer cutoff from this case. Calibrate with exact references and additional completed 500K outcomes.
reopen_conditions: Exact original 100K GPTrans reference checkpoint becomes locally available for a matched recheck.

comparison_blockers: Candidate and reference checkpoints came from separately accepted 100K runs.
